title: 第13章 三名少女竟当街暴打五十旬老头第14章 宗主怒刷一万个大唢呐
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第13章三名少女竟当街暴打五十旬老头？“可恶。”
老头又接连几下打在保护罩上，确认自己无可奈何决定忍痛逃跑。
邪修修炼速度快，但寿元却比正道弟子短。
一般的金丹有五百到八百年寿元，而邪修只有三百到五百年。
他如今寿元将尽，始终无法结婴，才铤而走险来这逍遥镇寻找机缘。
刚才他躲在暗处，见一个炼气期的小丫头居然买走了元婴妖兽，便动了心思，打算抢完就跑。
没想到，她身上竟有如此法宝。
“休想跑。”
云洛手指翻飞，缚仙索自袖中飞出，如蛟龙出海袭向老者。
可老头修为本就高，平日偷摸拐骗更是将逃跑技能点满。
云洛又只有炼气期，无法将缚仙索的速度发挥到极致。
缚仙索只挨到老头的衣角就被他逃了。
云洛心中正可惜，眼前寒光一现，等她看清，只见一柄灵剑悬于半空，剑尖直指老头额心。
那剑，剑身修长而凌厉，周身流转着暗金色光芒，剑刃之上，隐约可见符文游走，似有毁天灭地之力。
云洛没有多看，再次以灵力催动缚仙索。
“缚！”
缚仙索这次没有遇到阻碍，将人绑得如同超市里的大闸蟹。
她飞快在玉简给褚璃两人发了消息，随后撤下保护罩，走向裴砚清。
“多谢道友出手相助。”
这邪修失手，若是还让他跑掉了，恐会伤害小镇里的其他人。

裴砚清收回灵剑，神识锁定邪修，惜字如金∶
“不必。”
此刻，褚璃和苏羡鱼御剑赶来。
“小师妹，可有受伤？”
两人抓着她的胳膊细细查看。
“我没事，师父给的法宝厉害着呢。”
苏羡鱼走上前对着老头的腰子狠狠踹了一脚。
“活腻歪了，敢在合欢宗的地界动手。”
清晰的骨裂声响起，在场的男人觉得那脚仿佛踹在了自己身上。
褚璃也走过去，两人对老头来了顿混合双打。
“我不敢了，仙子饶命，仙子饶命。”
content_en:
Chapter 13 Three girls actually beat up a fifty-year-old man in the street? "Damn it."
The old man hit the protective shield a few more times, confirming that he had no choice but to endure the pain and run away.
Evil cultivators practice quickly, but their longevity is shorter than that of righteous disciples.
The average golden elixir has a life span of 500 to 800 years, while the evil cultivator only has a lifespan of 300 to 500 years.
Now that his life is almost over and he has never been able to conceive a baby, he took the risk and came to Xiaoyao Town to look for opportunities.
Just now he was hiding in the dark and saw a little girl in the Qi refining stage actually buying the Nascent Soul Monster, so he thought about it and planned to run away after grabbing it.
Unexpectedly, she had such a magic weapon in her body.
"Don't even think about running away."
Yunluo's fingers flew, and the immortal rope flew out of his sleeves, like a dragon coming out of the sea to attack the old man.
But the old man's cultivation level is already high, and his daily activities of sneaking and abducting have fully equipped his escape skills.
Yunluo was only in the Qi refining stage and could not maximize the speed of the Immortal Binding Rope.
The immortal rope only touched the corner of the old man's clothes before he escaped.
Yunluo felt regretful when a cold light appeared in front of her eyes. When she saw clearly, she saw a spiritual sword hanging in the air, the tip of the sword pointed directly at the old man's forehead.
The sword was slender and sharp, with dark golden light flowing all over it. On the blade, runes were vaguely visible, and it seemed to have the power to destroy the heaven and the earth.
Yunluo didn't look much and used his spiritual power to activate the Immortal Binding Rope again.
"Bind!"
The Immortal Binding Rope met no obstacles this time and tied the person like a hairy crab in a supermarket.
She quickly sent a message to Chu Li and Chu Li on the jade slip, then took off the protective cover and walked towards Pei Yanqing.
"Thank you fellow Taoist for helping me."
This evil cultivator failed, and if he was allowed to escape, he might harm other people in the town.
Pei Yanqing withdrew his spiritual sword, his consciousness locked onto the evil cultivator, and he cherished the words like gold:
"No need."
At this moment, Chu Li and Su Xianyu arrived with swords.
"Little junior sister, are you injured?"
The two of them grabbed her arms and examined her carefully.
"I'm fine. The magic weapon Master gave me is very powerful."
Su Xianyu stepped forward and kicked the old man hard on the waist.
"I'm so tired of living that I dare to take action in the Hehuan Sect's territory."
There was a clear sound of bone cracking, and the men present felt as if the foot was kicking on themselves.
Chu Li also walked over, and the two played a mixed doubles match against the old man.
"I don't dare anymore. Fairy, have mercy on me. Fairy, have mercy on me."
